calls.ai_first.executor: Retell inbound agent binding and inbound call context
calls.ai_first.limitation: The tenant still needs an active number and agent configuration.
calls.ai_first.evidence: Controlled inbound and outbound Retell calls completed with tenant-specific agent binding.

calls.simultaneous.executor: Carrier multi-leg routing when supported; otherwise Retell screens first
calls.simultaneous.limitation: A Ferocity-managed Retell number cannot ring the owner and AI simultaneously by itself.
calls.simultaneous.evidence: UI and call context disclose the limitation; live carrier certification remains required.

calls.owner_first.executor: Carrier routing when supported; otherwise Retell transfers promptly
calls.owner_first.limitation: A direct Retell-managed number reaches AI before a transfer and cannot truthfully promise owner-first ringing.
calls.owner_first.evidence: UI and call context disclose the limitation; live carrier certification remains required.

calls.important_only.control: Office Manager call mode and importance thresholds
calls.important_only.executor: Retell conversation context plus post-call call-management decision engine
calls.important_only.limitation: Pre-answer importance cannot be known on a direct Retell number; transfer happens after screening.
calls.important_only.evidence: Classification tests pass; a live tenant transfer is not yet certified.

calls.ai_unless_requested.executor: Retell transfer tool after caller request
calls.ai_unless_requested.limitation: Requires a verified tenant transfer destination and a successful provider transfer tool call.
calls.ai_unless_requested.evidence: Transfer tool is configured; a live tenant transfer is not yet certified.

calls.schedule_based.control: Office Manager call mode and schedule
calls.schedule_based.executor: Workspace-timezone mode resolver and Retell call context
calls.schedule_based.limitation: Owner-first periods still inherit the active carrier's routing limitation.
calls.schedule_based.evidence: Deterministic schedule resolution is implemented; carrier behavior remains capability-dependent.

calls.presence_based.executor: Call-management resolver and Retell call context
calls.presence_based.limitation: Presence changes transfer policy but cannot add carrier features the connected number lacks.
calls.presence_based.evidence: Attention-state resolution is implemented; live transfer remains to be certified.

calls.custom.storedState: call_handling_modes rules, thresholds, categories and schedule
calls.custom.executor: Call-management resolver and Retell call context
calls.custom.limitation: Only rules supported by the connected carrier and agent tools can execute live.
calls.custom.evidence: Rule persistence and decision logic are implemented; UI now states the carrier boundary.

calls.transfer.control: Receptionist transfer destination and call mode
calls.transfer.limitation: Disabled until the tenant has a verified transfer destination; a live tenant transfer is still required.
calls.transfer.evidence: Provisioning requires a synchronized tenant destination.

calls.managed_number.control: Receptionist Setup managed-number selection and provisioning approval
calls.managed_number.storedState: phone connection, subscription and number-lifecycle records
calls.managed_number.executor: Idempotent managed-number lifecycle worker and Retell number adapter
calls.managed_number.limitation: A number is purchased only after explicit selection, eligible billing, synchronized voice agents, a verified transfer destination and provider activation. The requested local area code is subject to provider inventory.
calls.managed_number.evidence: One isolated QA number was provisioned; full two-tenant lifecycle certification remains open.

integrations.customer_revoke.control: Disconnect account on customer-owned integration cards
integrations.customer_revoke.storedState: integration, provider, lane, credential-vault, route, queue and mailbox state
integrations.customer_revoke.limitation: Ferocity access is revoked locally and credential material is erased; providers without a safe revocation API may still require removal from their own authorized-apps page.
integrations.customer_revoke.evidence: The disconnect path is included in local release checks and awaits the authorized deployment.

messaging.ferocity_connect.control: Messaging and Ferocity Connect service controls
messaging.ferocity_connect.storedState: device, consent, queue and service-control records
messaging.ferocity_connect.limitation: Final release requires physical outbound, inbound, STOP/START/HELP, offline and replacement certification.
messaging.ferocity_connect.evidence: Focused automated tests pass; physical certification remains open.

messaging.scheduled_sms.storedState: outbound message queue with workspace timezone
messaging.scheduled_sms.limitation: The source awaits the authorized deploy and one physical delayed-send test.
messaging.scheduled_sms.evidence: Scheduling, consent, quiet-hours and idempotency tests pass.

social.tiktok_login.limitation: This authorizes identity/basic profile only, not publishing or advertising.
social.tiktok_login.evidence: Production OAuth completed for the isolated QA workspace.

social.tiktok_publish.executor: TikTok Content Posting API adapter with creator-info and status checks
social.tiktok_publish.limitation: TikTok product approval, public-post audit, authorization and controlled production certification are incomplete.
social.tiktok_publish.evidence: Direct Post initialization, creator validation, status polling and approval gates are implemented locally.

social.tiktok_ads.control: Provider certification status and campaign approval
social.tiktok_ads.storedState: provider certification, approval and budget gates
social.tiktok_ads.limitation: The Ads Manager account and billing are ready, but the API for Business app still needs approval, authorization and controlled campaign certification.
social.tiktok_ads.evidence: Business OAuth, advertiser discovery, campaign reads, reporting and a gated campaign-create adapter are implemented locally; live ad actions remain off.

social.facebook_marketplace.storedState: tenant-specific device, session, queue and health records
social.facebook_marketplace.limitation: Meta review, final deploy and physical worker recovery certification remain open.
social.facebook_marketplace.evidence: Worker recovery tests pass; production certification is not complete.

email.mailbox_read.storedState: encrypted tenant mailbox OAuth credentials and normalized messages
email.mailbox_read.limitation: A customer must connect and authorize a supported read-only mailbox. Sending remains a separate unreleased capability, and Gmail availability remains connection-dependent.
email.mailbox_read.evidence: The deployed Netlify background function completed a production Microsoft mailbox sync of 10 messages with encrypted OAuth refresh, normalized storage, no send authority and no retained error.

email.mailbox_send.control: No customer mailbox send control is released
email.mailbox_send.limitation: Sending needs separate opt-in scopes, sender identity, audit, consent, rate limits and approval controls.
email.mailbox_send.evidence: Read-only mailbox access is intentionally separate from transactional Resend email.

marketing.organic_publish.control: Marketing OS cadence and publishing queue
marketing.organic_publish.storedState: brand opt-in, quality review, approvals and publishing queue
marketing.organic_publish.limitation: Uncertified destinations produce drafts/exports and cannot publish live.
marketing.organic_publish.evidence: Quality and provider gates pass locally; controlled multi-channel production certification remains open.

marketing.paid_spend.storedState: approval, provider, budget and service-control records
marketing.paid_spend.limitation: Each destination needs a funded approved account, explicit limits and live certification.
marketing.paid_spend.evidence: No unsupported provider is allowed to execute spend.

expenses.document_intelligence.control: Expense document upload, batch and email intake
expenses.document_intelligence.storedState: shared document intelligence, extraction, allocation and review records
expenses.document_intelligence.limitation: Low-confidence extraction, ambiguous allocation and possible duplicates require human review; Ferocity preserves the source and does not present management reports as filed tax returns.
expenses.document_intelligence.evidence: Production deployment 6ac33eca7152ff76e967a274 served the authenticated QA workspace with 27 preserved documents, paginated review, private originals and no horizontal overflow after local 5 MB, near-15 MB, 25-file, duplicate, interruption and authorization certification.
